notes.title: Game update & french version
notes.content:
Update

- "Dr.Commodore Logs" are now available in the right order even if you discover computers in a strange order.
- French version! (Hello, mothertongue!)

notes.title: Shadows and secrets of Allan Commodore
notes.content:
Hello,

Allan was updated:
- A backstory was added through eight additional secrets.
- Asynchronous text was added in a lot of cases to avoid breaking the game rythm
- Particles and graphical effects were added (Concentration aura, blood...)
- When the character is very injuried, you will feel dizzy (a little)
- 3D with teal and red glasses : press F1 to trigger it
- Additional voices and texts
- An improved tutorial
- A level loading error was fixed - the kind that use to exit the game
- A game over screen was added
- The final fight area was soften
- The EFRITS splash screen was added: the computer science and information technology school to which all gains are gonna be given.

notes.title: Soon in french
notes.content: Soon the game's gonna be translated too french. And then to italian. ;)

notes.title: Less flickering
notes.content:
Hello,

I have updated Allan to remove as much flickering as I can.
Corners should be stable now, and darken tiles should stay dark.

The last one was not tested in real condition as I was not able to reproduce the bug, but I've noticed a flaw into my raycast algorithm and fixed it. I suppose it was the main reason the whole screen would flicker under specific configurations.

notes.title: Race: Be part of the three first ones to win
notes.content:
Hello!

Allan was released this week...
There's several player trying to beat it but currently no one has succeed. (I'm the one that unlocked the current successes :p to test them)

Record yourself while playing and send us a video right there. 

The three first ones to comment with a video in which the game is ended in [b]normal[/b], [b]hard[/b] or [b]real[/b] mode is gonna win an Allan key to offer. The rule is the following: no cuts from the start menu until to the victory ;) 
Hard mode player are gonna win an additionnal Macroboy Y key, and real mode player a MacroboyY+Melordandek couple of keys.

Go! :p
